enonce.texte: Read the descriptions of cultural practices and write a comparison using comparatives and superlatives.

questions.texte: Write a paragraph comparing celebrations in Cameroon and an English-speaking country (e.g., the USA or UK).
questions.reponse: Example: 'In Cameroon, weddings are often larger than in the UK. In the UK, people usually have smaller, more intimate ceremonies. Christmas is celebrated in both countries, but it is more commercial in the US. Eid al-Fitr is one of the most important celebrations for Muslims in Cameroon, while it is less common in the UK.'

enonce.texte: Prepare a short presentation (3-5 minutes) about a cultural practice or tradition in Cameroon. Compare it to a similar practice in another country. Use comparatives, superlatives, and 'used to'.

questions.texte: Present your findings to the class or a partner.
questions.reponse: Example: 'I would like to talk about wedding traditions in Cameroon. Compared to the US, weddings in Cameroon are much bigger. In Cameroon, people used to have very long ceremonies with many traditional dances. However, nowadays, many people prefer shorter ceremonies. In the US, weddings are usually more intimate. Both cultures share the tradition of celebrating with family and friends.'
